case_scope.source_excerpt:
Assume AC, the ultrafilter extension principle, DC, and HB, and the superstable regular model of [[thm-tdmath-continuum-variational-pressure]], $\beta>0$, and an interior attainable density $\rho>0$. Let $N_L/L^d\to\rho$, let $C_{L,N_L}$ be the free-boundary positional canonical law with exactly $N_L$ particles, and let $R_{L,\omega}$ be its periodized empirical field from [[def-tdmath-periodized-empirical-field]]. Choose any finite supporting activity $z>0$ of $F_\beta$ at $\rho$ and set
$$\mathcal M_{z,\beta}:=\operatorname*{argmin}_{P\in\mathcal P^1_{\rm stat}}\{I(P)+\beta\Phi(P)-\rho(P)\log z\}.$$
For every open $\tau_L$ neighborhood $U$ of $\mathcal M_{z,\beta}$,
$$C_{L,N_L}^*\{\omega:R_{L,\omega}\notin U\}\longrightarrow0.$$
Here $C^*(E)$ is the outer probability defined in [[lem-tdmath-canonical-empirical-field-conditioning]]; convergence in probability uses this convention, agreeing with ordinary probability for measurable events.
If $\mathcal M_{z,\beta}=\{P_*\}$, then $R_{L,\omega}\to P_*$ in probability in $\tau_L$. This is local observable equivalence for a uniformly sampled bulk location; it makes no claim about the raw finite-box law at a fixed origin or about uniqueness for every interaction.

case_scope.source_excerpt:
Assume AC, the ultrafilter extension principle, DC, and HB, and the superstable regular model and Poisson conventions of [[thm-tdmath-continuum-variational-pressure]], with stationary finite-intensity law space $\mathcal P^1_{\rm stat}$, intensity $\rho$, specific entropy $I$, and energy density $\Phi$ as there defined. Let $D\subset[0,\infty)$ be an interval of positive length and define
$$\nu=\sup\{\rho(P):P\in\mathcal P^1_{\rm stat},\ I(P)<\infty,\ \Phi(P)<\infty\},\qquad e_0(\rho)=\inf\{\Phi(P):P\in\mathcal P^1_{\rm stat},\ \rho(P)=\rho,\ I(P)<\infty\},$$
with the supremum of an empty set equal to $0$ and the infimum of an empty set equal to $+\infty$. If $\inf D<\nu$ and $e>\inf_{\rho\in D}e_0(\rho)$, define
$$A_L=\{N_{\Lambda_L}/L^d\in D,\ H_{L,\mathrm{per}}/L^d\leq e\}.$$
Then $A_L$ has positive Poisson probability for all sufficiently large $L$, and
$$\lim_{L\to\infty}L^{-d}\log Q_{\Lambda_L}(A_L) =-\min\{I(P):\rho(P)\in\overline D,\ \Phi(P)\leq e\}.$$
Let $R_{L,\omega}$ be the periodized empirical field of [[def-tdmath-periodized-empirical-field]], and let $B=\{x\in\mathbb R^d:\phi(x)=+\infty\}$. Define
$$\mathcal K_B=\left\{P\in\mathcal P^1_{\rm stat}:P\!\left(\left\{\omega:\forall x,y\in\omega,\ x\neq y\Rightarrow x-y\notin B\right\}\right)=1\right\}.$$
For $\beta>0$ put $\mathcal M_{\beta,z}=\operatorname*{argmin}_{P\in\mathcal P^1_{\rm stat}}\{I(P)+\beta\Phi(P)-\rho(P)\log z\}$; at $\beta=0$ put $\mathcal M_{0,z}=\operatorname*{argmin}_{P\in\mathcal K_B}\{I(P)-\rho(P)\log z\}$. Then there are $\beta\geq0$ and $z>0$ for which the empirical fields under the conditional law $Q_{\Lambda_L}(\cdot\mid A_L)$ and the matching periodic grand-canonical law concentrate in every open $\tau_L$ neighborhood of $\mathcal M_{\beta,z}$. If this minimizer set is a singleton, both empirical fields converge to it in probability in $\tau_L$. For a finite-volume law $C$ and arbitrary event $E$, define $C^*(E):=\inf\{C(A):E\subseteq A,\ A\text{ measurable}\}$. Concentration and convergence in probability here mean $C^*\{\omega:R_{L,\omega}\notin U\}\to0$ for every stated open neighborhood $U$; on measurable events this is ordinary probability. The law-space evaluation sigma-algebra is generated by $P\mapsto P(B)$ for measurable configuration events $B$. These are empirical-field conclusions. The periodically continued conditional and grand laws also converge in $\tau_L$ under the same uniqueness assumption, for all measurable local observables of at-most-linear count growth. The energy constraint is an upper event and $D$ is nondegenerate; this does not assert exact $N$, a shrinking shell, or a singular energy surface.
In the $\beta=0$ branch the finite periodic weight is explicitly $z^N$ times the indicator that no displacement between the configuration and any periodic image lies in $B$; no value is assigned to $0\cdot(+\infty)$.

Assume AC, the ultrafilter extension principle, DC, and HB, and the superstable regular interaction of [[thm-tdmath-continuum-variational-pressure]], $\beta>0$, and an interior attainable density $\rho>0$. For integers $N_L$ with $N_L/L^d\to\rho$, let $Z_{\mathrm{per}}(L,N_L;\beta)$ be the $1/N_L!$-normalized positional partition on the periodized cube, with the image convention of [[def-tdmath-superstable-regular-interaction]]. Then
$$L^{-d}\log Z_{\mathrm{per}}(L,N_L;\beta)\longrightarrow F_\beta(\rho),$$
the same rate as the free cube. Let $C^{\mathrm{per}}_{L,N_L}$ be the periodic exact-$N_L$ canonical law and $R_{L,\omega}$ its periodized empirical field from [[def-tdmath-periodized-empirical-field]]. For any finite supporting activity $z>0$ of $F_\beta$ at $\rho$, these empirical fields concentrate in every open $\tau_L$ neighborhood of the minimizer set of $I+\beta\Phi-\rho\log z$. Writing $\mathcal M_{z,\beta}$ for this minimizer set, the concentration means $(C^{\mathrm{per}}_{L,N_L})^*\{\omega:R_{L,\omega}\notin U\}\to0$ for every open $\tau_L$ neighborhood $U$ of it. Here outer probability is as defined in [[lem-tdmath-canonical-empirical-field-conditioning]], and equals ordinary probability for measurable events. A singleton minimizer gives convergence in probability in this outer-probability sense in $\tau_L$.
